private.project: The Residences at W Singapore Sentosa Cove

sources.hdb: Housing & Development Board (HDB), Resale Flat Prices, via data.gov.sg. Median resale price per block, flat type and year, over the same rolling 8-year window as the Miji Index above - for Check a Unit's same-block price-history view, not individual transactions.
sources.private: Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA), Private Residential Property Transactions, via the URA Data Service API. Median $ per square foot per project, property type and year. URA's Data Service only gives about the last 5 years of real transactions - unlike the Miji Index, older years are left blank here rather than projected, since an estimated point on one specific project's own chart would be misleading in a way it isn't on a townwide trend.
